d:
Uttar pradesh vidhanasbha chunav 2027 se pahle asduddin ovaisi aur chandrashekhar aajad ne 'samajik parivartan morcha' ke gathan ka ailan kiya hai. is gathbandhan men chandrashekhar aajad mukhyamantri pad ka chehra honge. donon netaon ne bijepi ko chunauti dene aur daliton, pichhron, alpasankhyakon aur vanchit vargon ke muddon ko uthane ki bat kahi hai.
Thank you for watching our video!
